title: utricularia × neglecta var. macroptera
intro: Utricularia × neglecta var. macroptera, commonly known as Bladderwort, is a rare carnivorous plant belonging to the genus Utricularia. Research suggests that this plant has potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Bladderwort are primarily attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antiproliferative effects, and demonstrate neuroprotective properties. The bioactive constituents of Utricularia × neglecta var. macroptera include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
